General reasoning benchmarks.description: Language understanding and reasoning scores for vision-language and 3D models. Higher scores are better.

3D captioning.description: Object captioning on Objaverse, comparing lexical overlap and semantic similarity. Higher scores are better.

3D generation.description: Text-to-3D and image-to-3D generation quality. CLIP measures alignment; lower FD and KD indicate closer agreement with the reference distribution.

PIE-Bench image editing.description: Image editing quality, background preservation, prompt alignment, and sampling cost on PIE-Bench. Standard and four-step settings are reported separately.

3D-POPE comparison.description: Object-presence reasoning under random, popular, and adversarial queries. Precision, recall, F1, and accuracy measure grounded answers; Yes-rate reports over-affirmation.

Anomaly detection on VisAnomBench.description: Interval-level anomaly detection and localization on the held-out VisAnomBench split. Precision, recall, F1, and overlap compare the predicted anomalies with ground truth.

MixedParts benchmark.description: Average performance across common objects, common parts, and unique parts. The first three metrics measure segmentation; SS and S-IoU measure semantic labeling.

htmlTable:0.title: OmniSocialBench social reasoning
htmlTable:0.description: Accuracy across social norms, action goals, mental states, and pragmatic meaning. Higher scores are better.

htmlTable:1.title: Public audio-visual benchmarks
htmlTable:1.description: Generalization from Qwen3-Omni-30B to CogniRoute on AV-SpeakerBench, OmniBench, MMVU, WorldSense, and Daily-Omni. Higher scores are better.

htmlTable:2.title: Additional video and audio benchmarks
htmlTable:2.description: Accuracy on AV-Odyssey, MVBench, MMAU, OmniVideoBench, and Video-MME-v2. Higher scores are better.

DIGIT-FIVE accuracy.description: Target-domain accuracy on DIGIT-FIVE, averaged over five runs. Higher scores are better; reported gains compare DaSH with competing selectors.

DomainNet accuracy.description: Target-domain accuracy across DomainNet domains, averaged over five runs. Higher scores are better.

Object generation.description: Object generation across four benchmarks. Lower Chamfer Distance (CD) and Earth Mover’s Distance (EMD) indicate better geometric agreement.

Text–shape alignment.description: Object-level and part-level text–shape alignment across the evaluated categories. Higher scores are better.

SNLI-VE accuracy across training-set siz.description: Visual entailment accuracy with and without emergent-communication pretraining across training-set sizes.

Instruction-following evaluation.description: Multimodal instruction-following results, with model size and training data reported alongside benchmark scores.

MMBench evaluation.description: Multimodal understanding on MMBench, comparing standard pretraining with emergent-communication pretraining.

Confidence elicitation.description: Calibration error (ECE) and failure prediction (AUROC) compare elicited confidence across agents and reasoning strategies.

Execution policies and confidence estima.description: Select an agent to compare confidence calibration and failure prediction across action sampling, scenario reinterpretation, and hypothetical reasoning.

FiVE editing accuracy.description: Instruction-following accuracy on the FiVE benchmark. Higher scores indicate better agreement with the requested edit.

FiVE fidelity and perceptual metrics.description: Video quality and fidelity on FiVE, comparing perceptual quality with preservation of the source content.

IVEBench and curated editing evaluation.description: Editing quality on IVEBench and curated subject-guided and general video-editing examples.

htmlTable:0.title: X-Ego benchmark
htmlTable:0.description: Semantic, perceptual, and temporal quality on the X-Ego benchmark. Arrows indicate the preferred direction of each metric.

htmlTable:1.title: Enhanced baseline variants
htmlTable:1.description: Comparisons with external-view conditioning (+EV), text-only adaptation (+TT), and the proposed conditioning inputs (+CI).

htmlTable:2.title: User study
htmlTable:2.description: Ratings on a 1–5 scale from 20 annotators over 25 video groups. Higher scores are better; asterisks mark enhanced baseline variants.

htmlTable:0.title: Text-to-3D generation
htmlTable:0.description: Prompt alignment and generated-shape quality, measured with CLIP, FD, KD, and Q-Align.

htmlTable:1.title: 3D object captioning
htmlTable:1.description: Lexical and semantic similarity between generated object descriptions and reference captions. Higher scores are better.

htmlTable:0.title: Interaction-centric MoveBench
htmlTable:0.description: Video quality and motion control on the interaction-centric MoveBench subset, with training data, trainable parameters, and inference time.

htmlTable:1.title: Multi-object MoveBench
htmlTable:1.description: Perceptual, reconstruction, temporal, and motion quality on the harder multi-object subset.

Counterfactual segmentation evaluation.description: Factual and counterfactual segmentation across referral and reasoning tasks. IoU drops and confusion-mask scores expose unsupported segmentation.

htmlTable:0.title: ImageNet-50K image generation
htmlTable:0.description: Generation quality and inference cost on ImageNet-50K. Active parameters and relative runtime show the cost per sampling step.

htmlTable:1.title: Multimodal understanding
htmlTable:1.description: Understanding benchmarks compare LaTtE-Flow with other multimodal models after adding image generation.

Textual planning evaluation.description: Textual plan quality on RecipePlan and WikiPlan.

Cross-modal planning evaluation.description: Step-level agreement between visual and textual plans.

Visual Step Ordering (VS-Ordering).description: Visual sequence ordering evaluates whether generated steps follow a coherent procedure.

Detector performance across datasets.description: AUC-ROC scores for 24 anomaly detectors across 19 multivariate datasets.

How detector scores vary across time ser.description: Score distributions across time series. Select a metric to compare variability across detectors.

Detector runtime by dataset.description: Runtime across detectors and datasets. The logarithmic color scale distinguishes fast and computationally expensive methods.

Detector selection performance.description: Detector-selection quality for MetaOD, FMMS, and Orthus across the benchmark’s scoring metrics.

Recovering the best detector: Recall@k.description: Recall as the number of recommended detectors increases.

Ranking quality among the top three reco.description: Precision, recall, and ranking quality within the first three detector recommendations.

Robustness in real-world manipulation.description: Long-horizon task completion under relocation, unfamiliar lighting, and visual distractions.

htmlTable:2.description: Overall video quality and five dimensions: creativity, commonsense, controllability, human fidelity, and physics.

Multi-image reasoning segmentation.description: Segmentation performance on M4Seg for general-purpose and pixel-grounded vision-language models.

Reconstruction quality.description: Reconstruction quality and inference cost on WebVid-10M and COCO-Val. Latency is measured on 25 frames at 256 × 256 using one V100 GPU.

htmlTable:0.description: Training and inference cost, token counts, and geometric error under the reported A100 setup. Lower scores are better.

htmlTable:1.description: Geometric reconstruction, occupancy overlap, and topology. F-scores use thresholds of 0.01 and 0.005.

htmlTable:2.description: Prompt alignment, distributional quality, visual fidelity, and coverage for generated 3D objects.

Qualitative spatial relations.description: Accuracy on relative-position and relative-size questions in SpatialRGPT-Bench.

Quantitative spatial measurements.description: Accuracy on distance, width, height, and direction questions in SpatialRGPT-Bench.

Multimodal understanding.description: Multimodal understanding across general, mathematical, and visual reasoning benchmarks.
